Daily targets
Planned targets automatically carry forward from the previous saved day, including edits. Saving never changes earlier days. Actual counts come from recorded work. Opening or printing a record never counts as work.

Unfinished Targets
Regular daily targets stay unchanged. Extra achievement reduces earlier unfinished targets. Earlier surplus never pre-completes a later target. Monthly and till-date views show the same work over different periods; do not add the two balances.


Unfinished tasks keep their original date and grow overdue. Targets stay on the day they were planned. Data is included in OneDB backup and sync. Reminders appear when you open the monitor.
